notes: A known defect is each item's own defect on its broken page.
Fixed-state alarm: a finding on a fixed page that points at that item's defect element and calls it broken in the way the defect describes.
Defects listed under also_present are real where the entry says; reports of them are valid extras.
A table, code block, list or select that scrolls inside its own box (overflow: auto) is not a defect; a report of it is unsupported.

The saved pages load nothing from other sites, so pictures from other sites (picsum.photos, i.redd.it and similar) are missing in both states; a report that only says such media is missing is unsupported.

The plainadmin page links assets/css/LineIcons.css, which its repository stores as lineicons.css, so its icon glyphs are missing in both states; a report that only says icons are missing is unsupported.
